description: This file implements the SessionServerManager class, which manages the lifecycle and state transitions of a session server, including initialization, configuration, state switching, and logging. It interacts with various services such as playback, cdm, control, and session management servers, and handles service start/stop and state change events.

classes.name: SessionServerManager
classes.description: Manages the lifecycle, configuration, and state transitions of a session server, including initialization, starting/stopping services, and handling state changes.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Initializes the session server with command-line arguments, setting up the application management server.

methods.name: startService
methods.description: Blocks until the service is stopped.

methods.name: stopService
methods.description: Stops the service and notifies waiting threads.

methods.name: setConfiguration
methods.description: Configures the session server with socket name, state, resource limits, display name, and permissions, then starts the session management server.

methods.name: setState
methods.description: Sets the session server's state to ACTIVE, INACTIVE, or NOT_RUNNING, handling the necessary transitions.

methods.name: setLogLevels
methods.description: Sets log levels for various components and propagates them to the session management server.

methods.name: ping
methods.description: Pings the control service with a given ID and acknowledgment sender.

methods.name: switchToActive
methods.description: Transitions the session server to the ACTIVE state, involving services and event notifications.

methods.name: switchToInactive
methods.description: Transitions the session server to the INACTIVE state, involving services and event notifications.

methods.name: switchToNotRunning
methods.description: Transitions the session server to the NOT_RUNNING state, releasing resources and notifying the application management server.
